### Breaking a Forty-Year Habit - One Year Devotions for Women
Author: Jill Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-women/breaking-a-forty-year-habit-one-year-devotions-for-women-january-25.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 1:6
Points:
- God told the Israelites at Mount Sinai that they had stayed in place long enough and needed to advance.
- The people were decades behind the divine schedule toward Canaan because of past rebellion and wilderness wandering.
- Believers today can easily fall into spiritual inertia and stall in their personal walk with God.
- Moving forward requires breaking out of spiritual ruts in areas like prayer, Bible study, and evangelism.
- God graciously extends new opportunities to resume progress, walking alongside His people when they choose to obey.
